name: The Divination
summary: Thadius Grimshade asks you to give him room while he performs a ritual of divination. He means to follow the link between the feather you brought and its owner until it leads him to Sharpbeak.

sections.title: A Ritual of Divination
sections.body: Thadius follows the link between Sharpbeak's feather and the gryphon who owns it, hoping to reach Sharpbeak himself. He asks for silence and room to work. He admits it may not go to plan, and warns that in that case you had better close your eyes.

sections.title: When the Ritual Ends
sections.body: The ritual succeeds. Thadius has glimpsed Sharpbeak and is able to tell you where to look.

faq.q: What is Thadius Grimshade doing in this ritual?
faq.answer: Thadius performs a ritual of divination. He seeks the link between the feather you brought and Sharpbeak, and means to follow it to Sharpbeak himself.
Sharpbeak is the gryphon child whose feather you brought to Thadius, and whom Gryphon Master Talonaxe has been trying to find.
Thadius warns that if the ritual does not go according to plan, you had better close your eyes. He asks you to give him room while he works.
